mapper.select: SELECT id,phone_hash,purpose,code_hash,expires_at,attempts,consumed_at,created_at FROM sys_sms_code WHERE phone_hash=#{phoneHash} AND purpose=#{purpose} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_sms_code SET consumed_at=#{now} WHERE phone_hash=#{phoneHash} AND purpose=#{purpose} AND consumed_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_sms_code SET consumed_at=CASE WHEN attempts+1>=5 THEN #{now} ELSE consumed_at END,attempts=attempts+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND attempts<5 AND consumed_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_sms_code SET consumed_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND attempts<5 AND expires_at>#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,password_hash,created_at FROM sys_password_history WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 5
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_password_history WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM sys_password_history WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 5) latest)
